# Recruitment Cost Calculator — Manpower

> Calculate the total cost of recruitment including direct expenses, labor hours, and the hidden costs of vacancies and bad hires.

This calculator provides an estimate of the full cost of hiring a new employee, covering direct recruitment expenses, internal labor hours spent on the process, and the financial impact of a position remaining vacant. It also factors in risk scenarios such as a bad hire. All costs are proportionally calculated against the monthly total employee cost. The tool supports both Estonian and English.

## Pages

- [Calculator](/): Interactive recruitment cost calculator with adjustable inputs for recruitment activities, labor hours, vacancy impact, and other services.
- [Print Report](/print): Printable summary of the calculated recruitment costs, formatted as a branded PDF-ready report.
